notes: Keyed by EXCHANGE ARRIVAL TIME of the order (TD5, 13 §6.3), never by market start (TD7: the WIP keyed it by market start and had 0 ms everywhere; both wrong).
Row windows are [from, to); the first row starts at the first market. Each epoch below was recomputed from its ISO label.

Applies only to orders marketable at exchange arrival on a market with taker_delay_enabled (CLOB itode; fallback true for BTC up/down). Non-marketable orders are not delayed; post-only orders are never delayed (TD1, a marketable post-only is rejected).
Rows D0–D3 are third-party (verification = ThirdParty); markets that hit them record the rule id in unverifiedRules and never count as gate-3 evidence (TD6, D52). Only D4 and D5 are changelog rows.
ts-compat: no taker delay at all (11 §4, TC-E10); taker_delay_enabled = false.

lookups.spec: 11 TD7, 13 §6.3 (keyed by arrival, not market start)

semantics.statement: Delayed iff marketable at arrival: BUY price >= best ask or SELL price <= best bid, on a market with taker_delay_enabled. Non-marketable: rests normally. Post-only: never delayed (rejected if marketable).
Accepted with status delayed: OrderAccepted, OrderDelayed{release_at}; REST returns zero amounts and no trade ids.

At release: re-validation against the state at that moment (market state, balance, risk, tick in force); failure -> OrderRejected{Exchange}; else match the book then; resting-type remainder rests (OrderOpen), market-type remainder killed (OrderDone(Killed, filled)); a FOK not fully fillable is killed with no fills.
A cancel arriving during the window fails with CancelFailed(NotCancelableDuringDelay) in rows with cancelable_in_window = false (D3–D5); it succeeds in D2.
arrival = send + place latency; match = arrival + delay; measured in exchange time; the simulator releases at the exact time.
Gamma secondsDelay > 0 on a BTC market replaces the dated value with secondsDelay x 1000 for that market, flagged unexpected_seconds_delay; secondsDelay = 0 is not evidence about the crypto delay.
